title: UK Games Industry Census – What have we learned?
description: Join Mark Taylor, University of Sheffield, and Cinzia Musio, Equity, Diversity & Inclusion expert at Ukie, who will exclusively reveal the findings of the UK Games Industry Census, and the UK Games Industry's action plan to address the results. In this presentation you will learn about the key findings of the industry-wide census, the biggest areas that call for action, and what everyone who works in games can do to support a more diverse and inclusive industry.
session_takeaway: Learn how the UK games industry has transformed since 2021.
Understand who has been most affected by layoffs and how their daily work has changed.
Learn specific actions you can use to support your workplace to enact positive, inclusive change.
